title: Sentinel: condensed trace dossier and Ops bridge for automated incident evidence
creator: Raj Patel
description:
Problem: When high-latency or error spikes occur we routinely lose time stitching traces, logs and dashboard evidence into a coherent incident packet. PagerDuty incidents surface alerts but lack structured, compact evidence that on-call can act on quickly. Existing playbooks require manual collection of traces and a separate Slack channel creation step.

Goal: Build 'Sentinel' — a service that listens to observability signals (traces, top-tier metrics, and log extracts), condenses them into a compact "trace dossier" (one-page structured summary + 2-3 annotated trace snippets + metric spike chart), attaches the dossier to PagerDuty incidents, automatically opens an ops Slack channel with the dossier pinned, and generates an initial postmortem skeleton populated with the summary and affected services.

Scope:
- Ingest upstream hooks from tracing service (sampling + trace id selectors) and metrics pipeline (anomaly detector).
- Produce a condensed dossier JSON and a small HTML preview for Slack and PD attachments.
- PD webhook enrichment: attach dossier and add suggested severity normalization.
- Slack Ops bridge: create #inc-<id> channel (private), post dossier, pin runbook link, and post triage checklist.
- Postmortem scaffold: create a template in the Postmortem repo with prefilled context and links.

Non-goals: full automated diagnosis or RCA, replacing human judgement on mitigation, or rearchitecting tracing storage. This is evidence orchestration and routing only.
acceptance_criteria: When an alert with tracing context fires, Sentinel produces a dossier within 30s that includes: one-line summary, affected services list, 2 annotated spans, top-3 correlated metrics, and 3 relevant log extracts.
PagerDuty incidents receive the dossier as an attachment and a normalized severity suggestion field without modifying existing incident routing rules.
A private Slack channel is auto-created for PD incidents marked severity >= P1; channel includes pinned dossier, runbook link, and a triage checklist message template.

A postmortem skeleton is committed to the Postmortem repo (or created as a draft in the PM Confluence space) with fields prefilled from the dossier: timeline, initial hypothesis, and related PR/commit links.
Canary rollout: 20% of alerts from staging org go through Sentinel for 2 weeks with no degradation to PD delivery latency (<=5s added).

Tracing: add lightweight sampling hooks and span extractor (owner: Runtime)
Metrics: anomaly hook integration and correlation engine (owner: Metrics team)
PD Integration: PD webhook enrichment + attach dossier storage (owner: Integrations)
Slack Bridge: auto-channel creator, pin logic, triage checklist template (owner: Platform UX)
Postmortem: scaffold writer that creates draft with links and timeline (owner: PM tooling)
Security review & KMS gating for any attached artifacts (owner: Security)
E2E QA: simulated alerts, PD + Slack verification, canary metrics (owner: SRE)
Rollout Plan: canary -> 50% -> all, rollback criteria and monitoring
